assumptions.film: All selected policies use the optional adapter once per call; widths are not published.
assumptions.style: Eight temporal uses per parameter, an upper allowance from the eight-step input; exact widths are not published.
assumptions.events: One incoming ball per second is a normalization assumption, not a measured event count.
assumptions.spin: Allow five queries for every incoming ball, including rallies; actual classifier is used on serves. Two output logits and ReLU hidden activation are assumed.
